sources.name: 2024 ACS TIGERweb places and census tracts
sources.access: ArcGIS REST GeoJSON, layers 82 (counties), 28, 30 (places), 8 (tracts); object-ID batches prevent truncation
sources.coverage: Nine Bay Area counties plus Tracy and Mountain House in San Joaquin County
sources.source_crs: ArcGIS service reprojection requested explicitly as EPSG:4326
sources.limitations: 2024 statistical boundaries may differ from current incorporated limits. Mountain House is selected by name from incorporated/CDP layers; no boundary is invented.

sources.name: 2024 ACS five-year B17001 poverty estimates
sources.access: Census JSON API; state 06; counties 001,013,041,055,075,081,085,095,097,077; all tracts
sources.coverage: Nine Bay Area counties plus Tracy and Mountain House in San Joaquin County
sources.limitations: 2020–2024 survey estimates, not observed heat. Margins of error retained. Whole-tract estimates are attached to clipped polygons without allocating counts to the clipped fraction.

retrieval_date: Recorded per run as retrieved_at in data/output/bundle.json
unavailable_inputs: Baseline Census build has no environmental inputs; run scripts/environment.py and its building pass for enrichment.
Utilities, parcel permissions, detailed setbacks, conservation easements and site-specific planting feasibility remain unverified.
